content.short: MantleGPT by Y-Dev is an AI assistant trained on Mantle documentation and codebases, providing instant technical support for Mantle developers.
content.description: MantleGPT is an AI-powered developer relations tool built by Y-Dev that has been specifically trained on all Mantle Network documentation, codebases, and technical resources. The tool acts as a virtual developer advocate, answering technical questions about building on Mantle, explaining smart contract deployment, helping with debugging, and guiding developers through the ecosystem's tools and protocols. MantleGPT dramatically reduces the onboarding time for developers new to the Mantle ecosystem by providing instant, contextually accurate technical guidance.
content.meta: MantleGPT is an AI assistant trained on Mantle docs and codebases to support developers building on Mantle. Discover MantleGPT on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
